# @file

macro(declare_internal_library libname)
	string(TOUPPER ${libname} libname_upper)
	string(TOLOWER ${libname} libname_lower)
	# Add dev includes and build includes as possible include dir
	# Build includes are required because of ui_xxx.h generated files
	# Dev includes are required because they are use before being copy in build directory
	set(${libname_upper}_INCLUDE_DIRS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/lib${libname_lower}/include"
					  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lib${libname_lower}/include")
	add_subdirectory(lib${libname_lower})
endmacro()

function(pv_qt6_wrap_ui outfiles include_dir)
	set(options)
	set(oneValueArgs)
	set(multiValueArgs OPTIONS)

	cmake_parse_arguments(_WRAP_UI "${options}" "${oneValueArgs}" "${multiValueArgs}" ${ARGN})

	set(ui_files ${_WRAP_UI_UNPARSED_ARGUMENTS})
	set(ui_options ${_WRAP_UI_OPTIONS})

	foreach(it ${ui_files})
		get_filename_component(outfile ${it} NAME_WE)
		get_filename_component(infile ${it} ABSOLUTE)
		set(outfile ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/../include/${include_dir}/ui_${outfile}.h)
		add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${outfile}
			COMMAND Qt6::uic
			ARGS ${ui_options} -o ${outfile} ${infile}
			MAIN_DEPENDENCY ${infile} VERBATIM)
		list(APPEND ${outfiles} ${outfile})
	endforeach()
	set(${outfiles} ${${outfiles}} PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

macro(declare_customer_cap cap default_dev default_customer)
	# Default value
	if (NOT DEFINED ${cap})
		if (SQUEY_DEVELOPER_MODE)
			set(${cap} ${default_dev})
		else()
			set(${cap} ${default_customer})
		endif()
	endif()
endmacro()

###############################################################################
# Function to define a test
#
# Syntax to use it : add_squey_compile_test(binary_name LINKS libs_to_link FILES files_to_compile)
#
# Compilation for tests declared with this function arre added to the testsuite
# dependency
###############################################################################
function(add_squey_compile_test test_exe)
	# Define all kinds of arguments
	set(options)
	set(oneValueArgs)
	set(multiValueArgs FILES LINKS)

	# Call cmake_parse_arguments to extract information in variables
	cmake_parse_arguments(_WRAP_TEST "${options}" "${oneValueArgs}" "${multiValueArgs}" ${ARGN})

	set(args ${_WRAP_TEST_UNPARSED_ARGUMENTS})
	set(files ${_WRAP_TEST_FILES})
	set(links ${_WRAP_TEST_LINKS})

	# Tests exercise the same path handling as the application, so they need the
	# same UTF-8 active code page (see utf8.manifest): without it, a test whose
	# paths hold a non-ASCII character silently reads and writes elsewhere.
	if (WIN32)
		list(APPEND files "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/utf8_manifest.rc")
	endif()

	# Now, we have all arguments, compile the executable
	add_executable(SQUEY_TEST_${test_exe} EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL ${files})
	target_compile_definitions(SQUEY_TEST_${test_exe} PRIVATE TEST_FOLDER=\"${TESTS_FILES_DIR}\" TESTS_FILES_DIR=\"${TESTS_FILES_DIR}\" TESTS_SOURCE_DIR=\"${TESTS_SOURCE_DIR}\")
	# Link library with it
	target_link_libraries(SQUEY_TEST_${test_exe} ${links})
	# All of this will be done on the already defined squey_testsuite target
	add_dependencies(squey_testsuite SQUEY_TEST_${test_exe})
	file(RELATIVE_PATH REL_TEST_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
	# OPTIONAL because the test executables are EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL: a build that only
	# runs the default target legitimately leaves them unbuilt, and the install must
	# not fail over it. When they are built, they are installed as usual.
	install(TARGETS SQUEY_TEST_${test_exe} DESTINATION "tests/${REL_TEST_DIR}" COMPONENT tests OPTIONAL)
endfunction()

# ctest only falls back to its own 1500 s default when DartConfiguration.tcl sits next
# to CTestTestfile.cmake, and the CI runs the testsuite from an artifact that does not
# carry that file. A test hanging there kept the whole job running until the CI killed
# it after its timeout, discarding the test output -- and with it any clue as to what hung.
# The slowest test observed on the Windows CI takes about two minutes.
set(SQUEY_TEST_TIMEOUT 600 CACHE STRING "Timeout in seconds after which a test is killed and reported as failed")

function(add_squey_test test_exe test_name)
	add_test(SQUEY_TEST_${test_exe} SQUEY_TEST_${test_name}${CMAKE_EXECUTABLE_SUFFIX} ${ARGN})
	set_tests_properties(SQUEY_TEST_${test_exe} PROPERTIES TIMEOUT ${SQUEY_TEST_TIMEOUT})
endfunction()

	#set_target_properties(SQUEY_BENCH_${bench_name} PROPERTIES COMPILE_FLAGS "-DSQUEY_BENCH ${PROGRAM_COMPILE_FLAGS}")
	#add_squey_test(SQUEY_BENCH_${bench_name} ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/run_bench.py ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/SQUEY_BENCH_${bench_name})

function(strcasecmp res str1 str2)
	string(TOLOWER ${str1} str1_lower)
	string(TOLOWER ${str2} str2_lower)
	string(COMPARE EQUAL str1_lower str2_lower res)
endfunction()

###############################################################################
# Speed up from-scratch compilation of a target via unity (jumbo) builds and
# precompiled headers. Both are controlled by the SQUEY_UNITY_BUILD / SQUEY_PCH
# options so they can be toggled off globally if needed.
#
# Syntax: squey_speedup_compilation(<target> [QT])
#   QT : also precompile the heaviest Qt headers (only pass it for targets that
#        actually use Qt, otherwise the PCH would fail to compile).
###############################################################################
function(squey_speedup_compilation target)
	cmake_parse_arguments(_SPD "QT" "" "SKIP_UNITY" ${ARGN})

	if (SQUEY_UNITY_BUILD)
		set_target_properties(${target} PROPERTIES
			UNITY_BUILD ON
			UNITY_BUILD_MODE BATCH
			UNITY_BUILD_BATCH_SIZE ${SQUEY_UNITY_BUILD_BATCH_SIZE})

		# Bundled third-party code and generated uic/rcc sources are prone to ODR
		# clashes (duplicated static tables, generated symbols such as the
		# qInitResources helpers) when merged, so keep them out of the jumbo
		# units. moc sources are the exception: merging them is safe (it is what
		# Qt's own mocs_compilation.cpp does) and there are many small ones, so
		# folding them in noticeably cuts the translation-unit count.
		get_target_property(_srcs ${target} SOURCES)
		foreach (_src ${_srcs})
			get_source_file_property(_generated "${_src}" GENERATED)
			if ((_generated AND NOT "${_src}" MATCHES "moc_") OR "${_src}" MATCHES "third_party/")
				set_source_files_properties("${_src}"
					PROPERTIES SKIP_UNITY_BUILD_INCLUSION ON)
			endif()
		endforeach()

		# Files listed by the caller define file-local debug macros (dbg,
		# print_*) or duplicated global helpers (__print_*) that leak into or
		# clash with the rest of a jumbo unit; compile them on their own.
		foreach (_src ${_SPD_SKIP_UNITY})
			set_source_files_properties("${_src}"
				PROPERTIES SKIP_UNITY_BUILD_INCLUSION ON)
		endforeach()
	endif()

	# Each target compiles its own PCH: the Qt headers bake in per-target defines
	# (e.g. QT_NO_OPENGL, set for some libraries but not the OpenGL-using views),
	# so a shared PCH (REUSE_FROM) is rejected as invalid for the mismatching
	# targets -- silently under -Winvalid-pch, fatally under -Werror.
	if (SQUEY_PCH)
		target_precompile_headers(${target} PRIVATE
			<algorithm> <functional> <memory> <string> <vector>
			<unordered_map> <map> <cstdint>)
		if (_SPD_QT)
			target_precompile_headers(${target} PRIVATE
				<QString> <QObject> <QVariant> <QWidget>)
		endif()
	endif()
endfunction()

# GCC version
macro(GET_GCC_VERSION major minor)
	execute_process(COMMAND ${CMAKE_C_COMPILER} -dumpversion
                    OUTPUT_VARIABLE GCC_VERSION)
	string(REGEX MATCHALL "[0-9]+" GCC_VERSION_COMPONENTS ${GCC_VERSION})
	list(GET GCC_VERSION_COMPONENTS 0 ${major})
	list(GET GCC_VERSION_COMPONENTS 1 ${minor})
endmacro()
